svg.text: Digital hourglass - GY-87 orientation and active buzzer
Hardware proposal v3.3 - existing display and button connections retained
Figure 1. Circuit diagram for the proposed v3.3 hardware.
All GND symbols share one net. All +5V points use the UNO 5V supply. BUZZER_D5 labels identify one common control net.
Q1 E/B/C are functional pins: identify the actual package before installation. D1 banded end K connects to +5V.
GY-87 and both matrices attach to one rigid support. New sensor and sound operation require firmware update and bench tests.
